claims.claim: LG DirectDrive 7kg washing machine for sale
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows LG branding, 'Inverter DirectDrive 7kg' text, and DD Motor emblem matching this description.
No photo evidence can confirm seller's physical location.

risks.risk: Unit may not power on or complete wash/spin cycle
risks.proof: Video of unit plugged in, powering on, running a full cycle with water fill, agitation, drain, and spin.

risks.risk: Rust spots on top and lower front panel may indicate deeper corrosion or structural/frame weakness
risks.proof: Close-up photos of rust areas from multiple angles, including underside and rear panel.
risks.if_unproven: priced as having significant cosmetic and possible structural damage

risks.risk: Missing power cord, hoses, and detergent drawer could mean extra cost to make unit usable
risks.proof: Photo showing power cord, inlet/outlet hoses, and detergent drawer present and intact.
risks.if_unproven: priced as incomplete, requiring replacement parts

risks.risk: Internal drum condition, leaks, or water damage not visible
risks.proof: Photo/video of open drum interior and underside of machine for leak stains.
risks.if_unproven: priced as having unknown internal condition, worst case

risks.risk: Digital display and button functionality unverified
risks.proof: Video showing display lighting up and buttons/dial responding to input.

risks.risk: Age and usage history unknown despite '10 Year Warranty' sticker
risks.proof: Photo of serial number/manufacture date label or proof of purchase receipt.

risks.risk: Slightly ajar bottom access panel could indicate prior repair or missing filter/pump cover
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the access panel area, open and closed.
risks.if_unproven: priced assuming possible missing or damaged component

proof_requests: Video of the machine powered on, running a full wash and spin cycle
Close-up photos of all rust-affected areas including rear and underside
Photo confirming presence and condition of power cord, hoses, and detergent drawer
Photo of serial/model label with manufacture date
Close-up of the bottom access panel, open and closed
response.reason: The witness clearly identifies a named, branded item, so it can be priced at worst case given unverified working condition and visible rust, pending further proof to raise the price.
